leds.evidence: Three LEDs (green, yellow, red) are visible on the right side of the breadboard.

found: Resistor connected to the green LED row

resistor_count.evidence: Two resistors are visible, each connected in series with the green and yellow LEDs respectively. The red LED appears to be connected directly to the rail/ground without a visible resistor in the same row.

led_polarity.evidence: The orientation of the LED legs is obscured by the breadboard and the angle of the photo.

button.evidence: A round blue button is clearly visible on the breadboard.

button_across.evidence: The button is placed across the central channel of the breadboard, with legs on both sides.

buzzer.evidence: A black circular buzzer is visible on the left side of the breadboard.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The blue wire from the GND pin on the Arduino is connected to the negative power rail of the breadboard.
